## Scope and limitations

Only the internal fixture was assessed. No public target was contacted. Inputs are authored lab fixtures; tool results are real.
This is an evidence-linked demonstration, not a complete security assessment. A reference match, open port or missing header alone does not establish exploitability.

network.title: Network inventory
network.prompt: Inventory the disposable lab network: resolve its address, discover services, verify HTTP and TLS, and write an evidence-linked report. Stay inside the internal lab.
network.summary: DNS and service probes are correlated with HTTP and TLS evidence. Open services are reported without treating exposure as an exploit.

services.title: Service assessment
services.prompt: Assess the local lab's exposed services. Correlate Nmap and HTTP evidence with SearchSploit references, verify applicability, reject unsupported matches and create a report.
services.summary: A catalog reference is inspected as a lead. Product/version prerequisites are compared with the observed lab service; a search match is not presented as a verified vulnerability.

website.title: Website assessment
website.prompt: Assess the disposable Atlas website using directory discovery, web fingerprinting, a narrowly authored Nuclei check and browser confirmation. Reject false positives and report verified findings.
website.summary: A debug endpoint is confirmed by independent requests, a local Nuclei matcher and a browser observation. An absent backup route is rejected as a finding.

tls.title: TLS and redirect review
tls.prompt: Trace the lab's HTTP-to-TLS redirect, validate its certificate using the supplied lab CA, compare headers across hops, check the browser behavior and save the evidence-linked review.
tls.summary: Each redirect hop is reviewed separately. The certificate is verified with the supplied local CA and the browser's certificate behavior is recorded honestly.

browser.title: Browser workflow review
browser.prompt: Review the local Atlas login flow with its disposable reviewer account. Inspect labels and error recovery, sign in, verify the destination and cookie attributes, and save screenshots and a report.
browser.summary: The native browser backend exercises a real local form. A failed login and successful recovery are verified before recording the dashboard and session-cookie behavior.

forensics.title: Layered forensic CTF
forensics.prompt: Solve the supplied layered forensic challenge. Follow clues from the PCAP to the carrier and archive, recover the encrypted payload, reject the decoy, verify the flag checksum and write a reproducible report. Do not use a prewritten solver.
forensics.summary: PCAP route fragments lead to an appended archive. The manifest guides AES/PBKDF2 decryption and zlib decoding; a failed key and decoy are rejected, then the recovered flag is checked against its manifest digest.

web-ctf.title: Web CTF
web-ctf.prompt: Solve the local Draft Room web challenge. Combine endpoint discovery, browser session state and request analysis, reject an incomplete request, verify the recovered flag and write an evidence-linked report.
web-ctf.summary: A discovered route requires both browser-established session state and a request header. An incomplete request is rejected, and the successful response is verified by its flag digest.

reporting.title: Evidence to report
reporting.prompt: Reconcile the supplied large review log with fresh local HTTP and scan evidence. Page the large artifact, note limitations and conflicting observations, and produce readable Markdown/HTML reports with an evidence index.
reporting.summary: Authored review-log inputs are paged and reconciled with fresh tool evidence. The report separates historical inputs from current observations and preserves explicit limitations.

recovery.title: Background-job recovery
recovery.prompt: Run a bounded background investigation of the local lab, inspect partial output, recover from a slow request, narrow the check and verify the rerun. Save the job log and a report describing the recovery.
recovery.summary: A background job is monitored using its returned ID. A deliberately bounded slow request yields partial diagnostics, then a narrower health check verifies recovery.

recheck.title: Remediation recheck
recheck.prompt: Record the local lab's debug endpoint and header configuration, apply the fixture-only remediation, repeat the same checks, compare before/after evidence and update the report. Do not change any external service.
recheck.summary: The disposable lab configuration is changed through its local control endpoint. Identical before/after requests verify that debug access closes and the declared response policies appear.
